sections.title: Cloud security & IAM
sections.subtitle: Review cloud architecture and identity controls to establish clearer access boundaries and stronger cloud foundations.

sections.heading: Reduce cloud and identity risk before production
sections.body:
A cloud rollout, access review or architecture change can expose configuration and identity gaps. Assess the agreed environment, record access risks and turn them into a risk-ranked hardening plan with remediation evidence.

Keep the scope clear: an advisory assessment identifies gaps; change-authorised implementation addresses them; an ongoing review is agreed separately. Link enterprise control evidence to [AI security & GRC](/services/cyber-security/ai-security-grc) and cloud build or migration to [Cloud services](/services/digital-transformation/cloud-services).

sections.heading: Agree the review and delivery scope
sections.description: Start with your cloud and identity environment and review objective. Do not send credentials, secrets or detailed architecture; agree a secure exchange after scoping.

items.title: Which environments and identities are covered?
items.description: Confirm your cloud and IAM providers during scoping. Agree whether workforce, privileged and workload identities, MFA, conditional access, service identities, secret handling and joiner–mover–leaver controls are included; coverage depends on the authorised environment.

items.title: Is remediation included in the assessment?
items.description: Not automatically. Read-only review and change-authorised implementation are distinct scopes. Agree change owners, exclusions, rollback, acceptance evidence and handover responsibilities before implementation.

items.title: What can an ongoing review cover?
items.description: Define access-review cadence, configuration changes, evidence refresh and reporting under the agreed arrangement. Hours, responsibilities and service measures are contractual decisions, not implied by a baseline assessment.

items.title: How do we engage and share information?
items.description: Fixed Price suits defined review or hardening work; Time & Materials suits evolving scope. Managed Service or Dedicated Team arrangements require agreed responsibilities and acceptance. Optional software is licensed separately. We can agree an NDA before reviewing confidential material; read our privacy policy before enquiring.
